# These are the C answers, emitted from PARENA/stdlib/shankpit/sky_rules.prn through
# SHANKPIT/packages/simulation/sky_rules.c. Never hand-edit a column: change the .prn, re-emit both sides, and
# regenerate these rows.
#
#   minutes weather tick | sun night visibility flash clock_hundredths
#
# `visibility` is a READING: 0 means "this weather has no fog to draw" (the matrix treats it as no fog at all),
# which is a different fact from "you cannot see". `flash` is a bolt, so it decays within a few ticks and returns
# on its own cadence.
#
